name: workflow-watch
description: Live session and Workflow tracker: main-thread turns, skills fired, spawned subagents, git commits and workflow stages with models, effort, tokens and timeline waterfall, drawn only in a side pane.

autoOpen.title: Open the Tracker pane automatically
autoOpen.description: On: the pane opens when a session starts and when work resumes after a quiet spell, unless you hid it this session. Off: only /tracker opens it.
